STATUTORY DETERMINATION UNDER SECTION 19 OF THE LAND REFORMACT, No. 01 OF 1972

MR. Dayawansha Chandrasiri Hewawidana who has given the Address Wawlugala Group, Imaduwa, has made a StatutoryDeclaration under Section 18 of th Act, and since he has demised, by virtue of the powers vested in the Land ReformCommission under Section 19 of the Act, a Statutory Determination has been made by the Commission determining theportion of agricultural land which the Statutory Lessee should be allowed to retain the portion of agricultural land whichthe statutory lessee was allowed to retain is indicated in the following Schedule.
T. A. SUMANATISSA THAMBUGALA,Chairman,Land Reform Commission.

01. The Lot Nos. 688, 689 in extent of 1.0925 Hectares (2A., 2R., 31.93P.) out of the land called “Anurasiri B Waththa”depicted in Final Village plan No. 87 Supplement No. 40, prepared by the Survey General and situated in the village, Wilpitain Minor Division Weligam Korale in Divisional Secretary’s Division, Athuraliya in the District of Matara in SouthernProvince and trees, buildings and plantation standing thereon.’
